svg.text: One EIGRP domain (AS 100) in two configuration styles: classic on R1–R3, named mode (ROMANSEIGRP) on R4–R7.
Every adjacency authenticated (MD5 or HMAC-SHA-256) · path control toward 4.4.4.4 on R1 and R7 · DHCP relayed to R4.
router eigrp ROMANSEIGRP · AS 100 · af-interface auth
4.4.4.4 via R2; R3 stays a backup (FS)
Edge router · host gateway + DHCP relay (R1, R7)
MD5 key chain (link touches a classic router)
Best path to 4.4.4.4 after path control

All values from the device running-configs in the CML export EIGRP; cabling from the links list. All links are 10 Mb/s IOL Ethernet with default delay, so R1 and R7 each have two equal-cost paths across the core.
